author: Will
name: FrogCrib
short: Full two-player cribbage with Ribbit Ribbucks rewards.
description: Traditional 121-point cribbage: private six-card hands, discards to dealer crib, starter cut, pegging, automatic scoring, statistics, and a configurable capped payout through The Royal Ribbit Reserve.
install_msg: Load with `$load frogcrib`. For rewards, also load `ribbit` and run `$ribbit setup`. Start with `$crib challenge @member`. Players must allow DMs from the bot.
end_user_data_statement: Stores each server member's cribbage games, wins, losses, total Ribbucks earned, and daily payout count/date. An active game's cards and participant IDs are kept only in memory until completion, inactivity, cancellation, or restart. Economic credits are held by Red's local bank through Ribbit.
